description: Rally the ProductClank community to engage with a specific social post. Creates a boost campaign and spends the user's credits: 'replies' generates AI reply drafts and 'quote' generates AI-drafted QUOTE POSTS (a repost WITH each member's own text, shown above the quoted post in their followers' feeds, the highest-reach action) — both cost 20 credits per draft, 10 drafts (200 credits) by default; set `count` (1–10) for a smaller boost, e.g. 3 replies = 60 credits. 'likes' (30 likes), 'bookmarks' (10 bookmarks — saving a post on X lifts its visibility) and 'repost' (10 reposts) cost 300 and ignore `count`. Supports Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit, Farcaster, and YouTube (replies + likes on YouTube; reposts only on X and Farcaster; quote posts and bookmarks only on X) — the platform is auto-detected from the URL. product_id is OPTIONAL: link a product (from search_products or create_product) to tailor replies with the product name, or omit it for a tweet-first boost that uses generic amplification language. A TikTok video under ~1 minute old has no caption yet: the boost is still created, drafts are generated once TikTok publishes the caption (usually within a few minutes), and credits are charged only then — the result says waiting_for_post_text. Pass post_text if you already know the caption to skip the wait. Delivery is immediate by default; to pace it (e.g. 'reply 3 times over the next 6 hours'), set spread_over_hours — one slot goes out now and the rest drip out 1–2 an hour so the last lands within that window, at the same price. On a TikTok / YouTube / Instagram Reel VIDEO, add watch_quiz for 'Watch & answer': viewers can also watch to the end and answer one counting question (a linked 24h watch quiz, billed 100 credits per correct answer on top of the boost price, up to max_answers — see create_watch_quiz). Confirm the action and its credit cost with the user before calling.

action_type.description: How the community engages. Default: replies. Reposts are Twitter/Farcaster only; quote posts (repost with the member's own drafted text) and bookmarks (members save the post) are X only.

count.description: Replies / quote only: how many drafts to generate, 1–10 (default 10). Billed 20 credits per draft — 3 replies = 60 credits.

post_text.description: Optional — the post's text or caption, if you already have it. Skips the server-side fetch (useful for a TikTok you just uploaded).

post_url.description: Full URL of the post to boost (any supported platform)

product_id.description: Optional product UUID (from search_products or create_product). Omit for a tweet-first boost.

reply_guidelines.description: Optional guidance for the tone and content of community replies or quote posts

spread_over_hours.description: Optional — pace delivery over this many hours instead of releasing every slot at once. One goes out now, the rest drip out 1–2 per hour. Minimum is ceil((items − 1) / 2) + 1 hours (3 items → 2, 10 → 6). Omit for immediate delivery. Same price.

watch_quiz.description: Optional 'Watch & answer' on a TikTok / YouTube / Instagram Reel video: a linked 24h watch quiz. Billed 100 credits per correct answer (default cap 20 = 2,000 credits), separate from credits_used. Get the questions and answers from the user, or from suggest_quiz_questions.

duration_sec.description: Video length in seconds, or "m:ss". Omit to read it from the TikTok / YouTube page; other platforms need it.

max_answers.description: People who may answer before the quiz closes to new viewers (default 20). Worst case = all of them right = 2,000 credits.

questions.description: 1–20 questions with their answers. Each viewer draws one. Get them from the user — you cannot watch the video.

question.description: A counting question only someone who watched can answer, e.g. 'How many times does she say "ship"?'

name: boost_post
title: Boost a social post
